# Load library and clear environment option

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(glmmTMB)
library(emmeans)
library(tidyverse) # data manipulation
library(broom.mixed) # for tidy model interpretation
library(emmeans) # estimating marginal means
library(DHARMa) # model diagnostics
library(glmmTMB) # running glmms
library(ggimage) # for adding images
library(patchwork) # for combining plots

rm(list = ls())
```

# Read data

```{r}
siq_data <- read_csv("~/Documents/MSI - GRAD SCHOOL/Siquijor Paper/McGlone_Siquijor Data/miya_siquijordiversity_statsrepo/Data/Siquijor_RData.csv", trim_ws = TRUE)
```

# Unique and total species analysis - pooled per habitat type only, not location

```{r}
species_by_habitat <- siq_data %>%
  mutate(habitat = str_trim(habitat),
         scientific_name = str_trim(scientific_name)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(scientific_name), scientific_name != "") %>%
  distinct(habitat, scientific_name)

unique_counts <- species_by_habitat %>%
  add_count(scientific_name, name = "habitat_count") %>%
  group_by(habitat) %>%
  summarise(
    species_recorded = n_distinct(scientific_name),
    unique_species = n_distinct(scientific_name[habitat_count == 1]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(percent_unique = 100 * unique_species / species_recorded)

unique_counts %>% as_tibble()
```

# Unique and total species analysis - per location per habitat

```{r}
species_by_habitat2 <- siq_data %>%
  mutate(
    habitat = str_trim(habitat),
    scientific_name = str_trim(scientific_name)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(scientific_name), scientific_name != "") %>%
  distinct(location_name, habitat, scientific_name)

unique_counts2 <- species_by_habitat2 %>%
  add_count(location_name, scientific_name, name = "location_count") %>%
  group_by(location_name, habitat) %>%
  summarise(
    species_recorded = n_distinct(scientific_name),
    unique_species = n_distinct(scientific_name[location_count == 1]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(percent_unique = 100 * unique_species / species_recorded)

unique_counts2  %>% as_tibble()
#overall richness per habitat per location type
```

## fix data to run a glmm comparing species richness per habitat type per location

```{r}
siq_data_glmm <- siq_data %>%
  mutate(
    habitat = str_trim(habitat),
    scientific_name = str_trim(scientific_name),
    location_name = factor(location_name),
    habitat = factor(habitat),
    samp_code = factor(samp_code)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(scientific_name), scientific_name != "")

# get species richness per samp_id
richness_data <- siq_data_glmm %>%
  group_by(samp_id, samp_code, location_name, habitat) %>%
  summarise(
    species_richness = n_distinct(scientific_name),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
#apparently you shouldn't pool transect data, so using samp_id data parin

```

# model fitting for species richness diffs per location_habitat

```{r}
# fit model neg binomial, habitat and location effects, including their interaction
richness_nbinom2_mod <- 
  glmmTMB(species_richness ~ habitat * location_name 
          + (1 | samp_code), # listing samp_code as a random effect because we looked at diffs in sp. per transect
  family = nbinom2(),
  data = richness_data)

#model validation
richness_nbinom2_mod %>% testUniformity()
richness_nbinom2_mod %>% plotResiduals() 
richness_nbinom2_mod %>% testDispersion()

#double check residuals test
sim_nbinom2_mod <- simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = richness_nbinom2_mod,
  n = 1000
)

plot(sim_nbinom2_mod)
testDispersion(sim_nbinom2_mod)
testZeroInflation(sim_nbinom2_mod)
testUniformity(sim_nbinom2_mod)

```

# Save / load model

```{r}
save(richness_nbinom2_mod, file = "Model_output/richness_nbinom2_mod.RData")

load("Model_output/richness_nbinom2_mod.RData")
```

# emmeans and pairwise comparisons

```{r}
# Compare habitats within each location
pairwise_richness_habitat <- 
  richness_nbinom2_mod %>%
  emmeans(~ habitat | location_name) %>%
  pairs(type = "response") %>%
  summary(infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), level = 0.95) %>%
  mutate(p.value = round(p.value, 3)) %>%
  as_tibble()

pairwise_richness_location <- 
  richness_nbinom2_mod %>%
  emmeans(~ location_name | habitat) %>%
  pairs(type = "response") %>%
  summary(infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), level = 0.95) %>%
  mutate(p.value = round(p.value, 3)) %>%
  as_tibble()
#mukhang no differences in richness in a habitat type regardless of location

```

## Predictions for plotting

```{r}
# predicitions and emmeans used for plotting (the predictions, not actual raw data)
pairwise_richness_habitat <- 
  richness_nbinom2_mod %>%
  emmeans(~ habitat | location_name) %>%
  pairs(type = "response") %>%
  summary(infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), level = 0.95) %>%
  mutate(p.value = round(p.value, 3)) %>%
  as_tibble()

pairwise_richness_habitat_newdata <-
    richness_nbinom2_mod %>%
  emmeans(~ habitat | location_name, #have 2 factors now so use ~
          type = "response") %>% #log scale to response scale
  as_tibble()
```

## Plot - species richness per habitat type per location

```{r}
#convert labels for habitats and order first
habitat_levels <- c(
  "Seagrass_bed_enhalus",
  "Seagrass_bed_thalassia",
  "Algal_bed_sargassum",
  "Reef_crest",
  "Upper_shallow_reef",
  "Lower_shallow_reef",
  "Upper_mesophotic_reef",
  "Lower_mesophotic_reef"
)

habitat_labels <- c(
  "Seagrass Bed (Enhalus)",
  "Seagrass Bed (Thalassia)",
  "Algal Bed (Sargassum)",
  "Reef Crest",
  "Upper Shallow Reef",
  "Lower Shallow Reef",
  "Upper Mesophotic Reef",
  "Lower Mesophotic Reef"
)

pairwise_richness_habitat_newdata <- pairwise_richness_habitat_newdata %>%
  mutate(
    habitat = factor(
      trimws(habitat),
      levels = habitat_levels,
      labels = habitat_labels
    )
  )

#plot - model
p_richness <-
  pairwise_richness_habitat_newdata %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = response,
             x = habitat,
             fill = location_name,
             color = location_name)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "North" = "#F02522",
    "South" = "#F0D622"
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "North" = "#F02522",
    "South" = "#F0D622"
  )) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL),
                  position = position_dodge(0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(~ location_name,
            ncol = 1,
            scales = "free_x",
            labeller = labeller(location_name = 
                                  c("North" = "North", "South" = "South"))
            ) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "Habitat Type",
                   guide = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "# Species",
                     limits = c(0, 35),
                     breaks = seq(0, 35, by = 5)) +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle("Species Richness") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_blank(), 
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12)
        )

p_richness
```
